functions.name: GET
functions.description: Lookup value from Teslin database. Returns metric value for entity at given time.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity name (e.g., fund name or company name)

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Data type: fund, positions, trades, benchmark, company - or model version for companies (e.g., Q4-2025-V1)

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Optional: Model version for companies (e.g., Q4-2025-V1)
